set.outcome:
**ux/Hotkeys built — a tiny, site-wide hotkey manager.** Live: [/framework/ux/Hotkeys/](/framework/ux/Hotkeys/).

- [x] one place, filterable, rebindable — `hotkeys_section()`: filter box + one row per action + "press a key or button…"
- [x] a mouse button is a first-class binding (owner's own thumb button) — back/forward navigation prevented
- [x] no nested per-panel scopes — one flat list, owner's own words quoted in [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ux/Hotkeys/doc/decisions/)
- [x] remembered per browser — `ext/Saver/LocalStorageSaver`
- [x] held key/button fires "down" once, not a flood

Already wired by the sibling minion's work found in this worktree (`ux/Dictate/push-to-talk.js`, `ext/drawer/tabs/settings.js`) — checked compatible; one real mismatch found and fixed, in doc/decisions.md.
